Vector-DB market & retrieval primitives (the naive-RAG default is now contested from three directions in one day — Pinecone's own compile-once knowledge layer, a Medium piece with production evidence that vector search is becoming plumbing inside existing stores rather than a product category, and a LinkedIn architecture argument pairing GraphRAG with MCP once lineage and governance become non-negotiable)

Vector DB market (the 'do you still need a dedicated vector DB' question got three answers in one day and none of them was yes - vectorless RAG where the data already carries enough structure, action-intent embeddings instead of lexical similarity, and the practitioner default landing on pgvector-until-it-hurts; RAGFlow is the only classical RAG engine still holding a trending slot)
